newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps may lower ITT Corp rating.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps may lower ITT Corp rating.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Wednesday it placed its triple-B rating of ITT Corp's senior debt on Rating Watch -- Down, following the company's announcement that it plans to split into three separate companies and spend $2.1 billion to buy back shares.
"The common stock repurchases, which ITT will fund by adding bank debt, will significantly increase ITT's overall financial leverage," Duff & Phelps said in a news release.
ITT had about $3 billion of total outstanding debt on June 30, 1996, Duff & Phelps said.

Because of the relatively high financial leverage and the comparative lack of business diversity, the ratings of the proposed Destinations and Information Services companies are not only very likely to be lower than those of current ITT, but also likely to be below investment grade, Duff & Phelps said.
